scope: Authored engineering diagnostics, not an independent quality or clinical benchmark

history.content: 我睡前总担心明天的工作，想找一些自我照顾的方法。

cases.check: Query should retain sleep/work worry context; no personal diagnosis.

cases.message: 我最近焦虑，暂时不想做呼吸练习，有没有其他放松方式？
cases.check: Query and kept evidence should support alternatives; no forced breathing tutorial.

cases.message: 什么是社交焦虑，和偶尔紧张有什么区别？
cases.check: Prefer topic sources, distinguish general education from diagnosis.

cases.message: 资料里有没有呼吸放松练习具体应该吸几秒、呼几秒、做几次？没有具体依据就别编数字。
cases.check: A named technique without timing details is insufficient to support numeric instructions.

cases.message: 我最近睡不好，白天又总靠咖啡撑着，想了解睡眠习惯和咖啡摄入方面的自我照顾建议。
cases.check: Preserve both sleep and caffeine concerns; identify uncovered facets.

cases.message: 知识库里有一种叫“紫色月球九步疗法”的方法吗？如果有，请列出每一步。
cases.check: No invented technique or steps; unrelated source chunks must not count as sufficient.
